account_topology._comment: GAM hierarchy: the reporting entity (selection_level) is the NETWORK (a REST report targets networks/{networkCode}/reports). discover_accounts lists networks the token can reach via networks.list. Core owns selection/access-check/trial/backfill (AD-2).

_error_map_note: This module is REST-only -- it speaks the Ad Manager API v1 (https://developers.google.com/ad-manager/api/beta/reference/rest), not the legacy SOAP services, so the SOAP ApiException reason enums (AuthenticationError.*, ReportError.*) are NOT what arrives here and are not keyed on. Codes come from the Google API error model the REST surface returns (https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/errors, canonical google.rpc.Code -> HTTP mapping) plus the classic reason strings of the Google API Console envelope. SHAPE THE KEYS MATCH: { error: { code: <numeric http>, message, status: '<ENUM>', errors: [{ reason }], details: [{ '@type': 'type.googleapis.com/google.ads.admanager.v1.*' }] } }. core.pull_errors._extract_provider_codes yields errors[].reason, then error.status, then error.code; error.details[] is NOT read by the generic extractor, so the actionable validation text a GAM 400 carries stays evidence on the typed error (provider_payload) rather than a key. error.code is never keyed on -- it repeats the HTTP status. WHAT THE MAP CHANGES vs the pure-HTTP classification: 403 quotaExceeded / rateLimitExceeded become provider_transient instead of permission_denied (retryable, as Google publishes them); 404 NOT_FOUND becomes invalid_request instead of unclassified (a network code or report id that does not resolve is not worth replaying); 409 ABORTED becomes provider_transient instead of unclassified. No 429 key: HTTP 429 raises core.quota.RateLimitError in _gam_request before classify_http_error is reached. No auth_revoked entry: the REST surface reports a revoked grant as the same 401 UNAUTHENTICATED as an expired token.

_max_provider_backfill_days_note: No max_provider_backfill_days is declared because The Ad Manager ReportService reference and reporting guides bound the report RANGE ('scheduled reports must end within 1 year of the start date') but never how far back data reaches (https://developers.google.com/ad-manager/api/reporting, checked 2026-08-17). Declaring a guessed window would promise a history the provider never committed to, so this module answers 'unknown' rather than a number (test_backfill_bound_is_declared_or_its_absence_is).
